title: Operational Decarbonisation Supports Enterprise Economic Resilience Across European Commercial Fishing Fleets: Replication Code
description: Replication codebase for data preparation, bio-economic panel integration, two-way fixed-effects econometric modeling, instrumental-variable identification, carbon-tax counterfactual simulations, and figure generation for the study Operational Decarbonisation Supports Enterprise Economic Resilience Across European Commercial Fishing Fleets.
